thread:
Anya (PM): ok team — Q3 planning sync: we need a concrete proposal for reserved pools + burst quotas + autoscaling policy. customers are asking for predictable throughput but also some temporary bursts.
Mike (Eng): can we split into two deliverables? 1) control-plane APIs + admin UX for pool sizing/quotas, 2) runtime autoscale + burst enforcement.
Anya (PM): yes — that's the proposal. Mike, sketch of scope: API to create Pool(resource_type=gpu, region, capacity_commit), quota model (baseline qps, burst tokens), admin console to set rollouts.
Mike (Eng): runtime concerns: implementing burst tokens + token bucket across multi-tenant GPUs is tricky. we either centralize quota checks (higher latency) or push leaky-bucket to agents.
Sophia (SRE): prefer token checks in agents with eventual central reconciliation. otherwise congestion at control-plane on gateways. also need circuit breaker for queue depth per pool.
Ram (Product Ops): risk: customers will want per-customer reserved pools vs shared pools with soft guarantees. we should define two modes: isolated-reserved (hard commit + preemption rules) and shared-reserved (guaranteed baseline, best-effort burst).
Laura (Sales): customers pushing for isolated-reserved. they see it as equivalent to renting a rack. pricing expectation: big uplift (>2x) for isolated. we need clear docs for sales to quote.
Anya (PM): launch criteria suggestion: 1) API + console for pool creation + edit, 2) runtime enforcement for baseline SLIs (p99 latency < target) under baseline load, 3) documented burst behavior + preemption policy, 4) 3 pilot customers signed.
Mike (Eng): engineering acceptance criteria: unit tests for token bucket logic, end-to-end test with synthetic workload showing autoscale from baseline->burst->cooldown, canary rollout plan in staging clusters.
Sophia (SRE): SLOs we should target for Dedicated pools: p50 < 20ms, p95 < 100ms, p99 < 300ms for generation requests at baseline. during burst we allow p95 <= 250ms and increase cost alerts.
Anya (PM): decisions needed from leadership: a) do we support preemption of shared pools to honor isolated-reserved? b) maximum burst factor (2x vs 4x baseline) and whether burst consumes ephemeral capacity or scales dedicated nodes.
Ram (Product Ops): suggestion: keep burst factor default=2x, opt-in 4x for enterprise with capacity underwriting. preemption: isolated-reserved cannot be preempted; shared can. document impact on fairness.
Mike (Eng): implementation notes: autoscale triggers: token exhaustion, sustained qps delta > 30% for 60s, or explicit admin override. cooldown 5m default. keep per-pool KV cache warm during scale events.
Laura (Sales): need a one-pager for pilots: list SLA, burst behavior, pricing addendum, migration guidance. I'll gather 3 prospects for pilots next week.
Anya (PM): ok, action items: Mike build API spec + proto by Fri (1769900000), Sophia draft SLOs/alerts + failure modes doc, Ram + Laura draft pilot agreement. we'll reconvene Tue for tradeoffs.
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline: created canary job for "reserved-pools-api" — trigger when PR lands. :rocket:
Mike (Eng): noted. I'll post the API OpenAPI snippet in #eng-platform once ready. any objections to default 2x burst?
Sophia (SRE): +1 default 2x. keep 4x gated behind manual capacity reservation.
Anya (PM): agreement noted. tagging @everyone for visibility. thanks all — saving this thread as the authoritative roadmap note for the feature.
